caption: The drawing features two rectangular textile patterns, one larger and one smaller, arranged vertically on a plain background. Both textile samples consist of horizontal and vertical stripes with a variety of intricate designs, including floral, leaf, and geometric motifs. Colors used in the patterns include shades of brown, purple, green, and red, arranged in alternating stripes and blocks. The larger textile has a border along its left and bottom edges and incorporates more densely packed motifs, while the smaller piece below mirrors a portion of the larger pattern but only in brown, green, and purple. Below the larger textile and to the left of the smaller one, the name "Florence R. Millto" is written in small, neat print. The overall composition centers the textiles on the page with ample neutral space surrounding them.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
